title: NHKマイルカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the NHK Mile Cup, where Seeking the Pearl also ran once, is here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From this point on, her path will diverge from her friends, who are all busy preparing for the Japanese Derby in the Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, El Condor Pasa sheds no tears. She heads to the race in good spirits to prove she is capable of taking on the world.
